method: Independent direct visual inspection of all eight candidate boards at native, 2x, and 4x scales. No pipeline code, manifests, prior verdicts, or goal documents read.

visible_reasons_by_scale.1x: A small load projects from the right hip and stays contiguous with the figure; it reads as carrying a container, though food details are too small to resolve.
visible_reasons_by_scale.2x: The shallow tan container and pale contents are visible beside the hip, with no background gap at the arm connection.
visible_reasons_by_scale.4x: The dark container outline and light contents form a basket-like load held low at the side. The visible pose does not bring this load toward the face.

visible_reasons_by_scale.1x: The low side load is visible, but the bent upper arm and bright patch near the face compete with the carrying gesture.
visible_reasons_by_scale.2x: The red and tan cluster under the chin and the raised forearm retain a hand-to-mouth impression despite the attached hip container.
visible_reasons_by_scale.4x: The container is connected low in front, but the other hand and colored chest/face cluster make the overall action look like eating while holding a container. This is strongest in rows 1 and 3.

visible_reasons_by_scale.1x: A bright red central cluster and raised arm dominate the tiny figure; the side basket is secondary.
visible_reasons_by_scale.2x: The hand is held high across the chest below the mouth while the small container projects from the hip.
visible_reasons_by_scale.4x: The high hand and red object-like patch under the face preserve an eating gesture in all four rows. Adding the low basket does not make the action unambiguously carrying.

visible_reasons_by_scale.1x: The small brown load is visibly separated from the right side of the body.
visible_reasons_by_scale.2x: Background is visible between the hip and rectangular brown load in every row, while both arms are raised.
visible_reasons_by_scale.4x: The supposed wood bundle floats beside the hip without a hand connection. The raised hands are near shoulder level, well away from this load.

visible_reasons_by_scale.1x: The hand and red patch beside the face remain prominent; the small hip load does not resolve the action as carrying.
visible_reasons_by_scale.2x: One hand is raised toward the face with a red item-like patch while the other side has a low tan container.
visible_reasons_by_scale.4x: The raised hand and red cluster beside the mouth/head strongly suggest eating from the low container. The basket itself appears attached, but the pose remains ambiguous in favor of eating.

visible_reasons_by_scale.1x: The bright red patch immediately below the face and inward bent arm dominate over the tiny low container.
visible_reasons_by_scale.2x: The upper hand and red cluster read as a food-to-mouth action above an attached container.
visible_reasons_by_scale.4x: A red item-like shape sits below the chin with the arm folded toward it. The hip basket is connected, but the figure still appears to be eating while holding it.

visible_reasons_by_scale.1x: The central raised-hand/red cluster is more legible than the side container, leaving an eating impression.
visible_reasons_by_scale.2x: The arm remains bent up across the torso toward the mouth; the basket stays low on the right.
visible_reasons_by_scale.4x: The high hand and red patch directly below the face suggest eating in every row. The attached hip container does not remove that reading.

visible_reasons_by_scale.1x: A detached brown rectangle sits to the right of the figure.
visible_reasons_by_scale.2x: There is a clear background gap between the right hip and load, with no reaching hand.
visible_reasons_by_scale.4x: The brown/yellow bundle remains disconnected from the body in every row. Both hands are raised near the shoulders rather than touching the hip-level load.
